shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && git status --short && for file in package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js'; do printf '\\n%s\\n' \""'$file"; cat "$file"; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'for file in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then cat "$file"; fi; done; rg --files -g '"'AGENTS.md' -g '.eslintrc*' -g 'eslint.config.*' -g '*test*' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.git'"' /workspace /home/vercel-sandbox/.codex 2>/dev/null | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && node --version && npm --version && cat .gitignore && curl -I --max-time 20 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=5'"
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && rg -n 'next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi(Request|Response)|router\\.(query|isFallback|events)|pageProps' app components lib next.config.ts && true"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && cat tsconfig.json && cat next-env.d.ts && node -e \"for (const name of ['playwright', '@playwright/test', 'puppeteer']) { try { console.log(name + ': ' + import.meta.resolve(name)) } catch {} }\" && rg --files app components lib"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- .gitignore tsconfig.json && git diff --stat && rg --files app components lib && cat .next/prerender-manifest.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && npx tsc --noEmit && test ! -d pages && if rg -n '"'next/(router|head|document)[\\x27\\x22]|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse|router\\.(query|isFallback|events)|pageProps' app components lib; then exit 1; fi"
